description: gitIgnoredAuthors: the mise lockfile workflow (on-ci-push-mise-update-lock) commits mise.lock onto Renovate branches as github-actions[bot]. Without this, Renovate treats those branches as manually edited and stops updating them. Repo-local because consuming repositories use different bot apps.
